rules.R1: PASS iff authority_source_id is an exact member of authority_sources; otherwise FAIL; missing/malformed -> HOLD.
rules.R2: PASS iff event_domain is an exact member of scope; otherwise FAIL; missing/malformed -> HOLD.
rules.R3: PASS iff valid_from <= event_time <= valid_to using ISO-8601 datetimes; outside -> FAIL; missing/malformed -> HOLD.
rules.R4: PASS iff actor is an exact member of actor_rules; otherwise FAIL; missing/malformed -> HOLD.
rules.R5: PASS iff subject is an exact member of subject_rules; otherwise FAIL; missing/malformed -> HOLD.
rules.R6: PASS iff action is an exact member of action_rules; otherwise FAIL; missing/malformed -> HOLD.
rules.R7: delegation must explicitly contain authorized boolean; optional actor/action fields must match event actor/action; true -> PASS, false/mismatch -> FAIL, ambiguity -> HOLD.
rules.R8: limits/exceptions are lists of objects with applies boolean; any applies=true -> FAIL, otherwise PASS; malformed/ambiguous -> HOLD.
rules.R9: trigger_rules are non-empty objects with satisfied boolean; all true -> PASS, any false -> FAIL, malformed/ambiguous -> HOLD.
rules.R10: superseded=false -> PASS; superseded=true requires effective_at; effective_at <= event_time -> FAIL, later -> PASS; ambiguity -> HOLD.
rules.R11: claim_object.state == runtime_state.state -> PASS; unequal -> CONFLICT; missing/malformed -> HOLD.
